metaDescription: Manage your UI preferences: theme, density, language.
title: Settings
lede: Per-user UI preferences. These are saved to your account and follow you across devices.
appearanceDescription: Theme, density, and language. Stored in identity.user_preferences.

theme.help: Choose how the platform should look. System follows your device setting; Light and Dark override it.

density.help: Comfortable spacing or compact for table-heavy workflows.

language.help: The language of the interface. Saved to your account, so it applies on every device you sign in from. Dataset content stays in the language it was written in.

signIn: Sign in to change your preferences.
